notes.zh-CN: 修复手机图片发送时误用电脑当前会话能力的问题，按目标会话检查图片支持；图片读取完成前禁止发送，切换会话后不再加入旧图片。手机输入区改为单行起步、自动增高，并合并常用操作；斜杠菜单根据键盘上方空间限高、滚动，长描述不再挤压推荐项。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备。
notes.en: Fix phone image prompts being checked against the desktop foreground conversation instead of the target session. Wait for selected photos to finish loading and discard stale results after switching conversations. The phone composer starts at one line, grows with its contents and combines common controls in one row. Slash suggestions fit the space above the keyboard, scroll and keep long descriptions within each option. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only.
